subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Neverlight Grove artifact
fact: The mushroom artifact from Neverlight Grove was the mechanism of corruption.
source_quote: The mushroom artifact from Neverlight Grove was the mechanism of corruption.

subject: Big Heart Fungus
fact: The Big Heart Fungus was the primary weapon, would need sustained damage, would not die quickly or easily.
source_quote: The Big Heart Fungus was the primary weapon, would need sustained damage, would not die quickly or easily.

subject: Grygum's crossbow position
fact: Grygum had a light crossbow; Thorin borrowed it and checked its mechanism before the fight.
source_quote: Grygum had a light crossbow. I asked him for it. Simple transaction... I checked the mechanism...

subject: Glyph of Warding trigger
fact: The Glyph of Warding was inscribed into the bridge stone; trigger: any hostile creature crossing.
source_quote: Jorlan started inscribing the Glyph of Warding into the stone itself... The trigger: any hostile creature crossing.

subject: Dust of Suleiman zone
fact: The Dust of Suleiman area was a tactical hazard on the cavern floor, intended to turn the priestess into someone else's problem.
source_quote: I looked at the Dust of Suleiman area... priestess plus that zone equals someone else's problem.

subject: Zalthir's teleport
fact: Zalthir teleported directly to Ilvara or grabbed her and moved her somewhere unpleasant.
source_quote: Zalthir said he could teleport directly to Ilvara — or grab her and move her somewhere unpleasant.

subject: Ilvara's magical items
fact: Ilvara's magical items were offered as additional payment, with the caveat that they might be contaminated.
source_quote: She offered Ilvara's magical items as additional payment, with the caveat that they might be contaminated.

subject: Glabbagool's eyes
fact: Glabbagool's eyes drifted left and right with unhurried curiosity, giving him away as not a rock.
source_quote: The eyes gave him away. They drifted left. They drifted right. They did this with the unhurried curiosity...

subject: Jorlan's position
fact: Jorlan was a threat with a location — stationary on the bridge, inscribing the Glyph of Warding.
source_quote: I looked at Jorlan across that bridge... Jorlan is a threat with a location, which is the best kind of threat...

subject: Ilvara's transformation
fact: Ilvara came apart into fungal matter beneath her feet, flowed through it, and reappeared elsewhere on the cavern floor.
source_quote: She came apart into the fungal matter beneath her feet — flowed through it like water pouring into a crack... and reappeared somewhere else...

subject: Big Heart Fungus cloud
fact: The Big Heart Fungus detonated a twenty-foot cloud of spore-thick poison that hung in the air like a settled entity.
source_quote: The cloud didn't drift... This hung in the cavern air like it had decided to stay — twenty feet of spore-thick poison...

subject: Dust of Suleiman
fact: Dust of Suleiman was among the tactical options laid out by the party for battlefield control.
source_quote: Glyph of Warding. Dust of Suleiman. Phantasmal Killer. Fireball.

subject: Asha's perimeter hold
fact: Asha would hold the perimeter once the party initiated, handling anything coming from outside.
source_quote: She would not come in at the start. Once we initiated, she would hold the perimeter — anything coming from outside, she handles it.

subject: Elevated platform
fact: The elevated platform was the initial position of Ilvara, and the site of Zalthir's teleport and first strike.
source_quote: One moment I was reading the geometry of the space — the elevated platform... and the next I was already there, adjacent...

subject: Fungal creatures
fact: Ilvara's allies had turned into mindless fungal creatures, a sign of her corruption.
source_quote: all of those allies she seems to covet have turned into fungal creatures that are mindless.

subject: Asha's immunological theory
fact: Asha and Jorlan remained uninfected — Asha through devotion, Jorlan through hatred, which is its own kind of immunological theory.
source_quote: Only she and Jorlan remained uninfected — Asha through devotion, Jorlan through hatred, which is its own kind of immunological theory.

subject: Twenty feet of maintained distance
fact: Twenty feet of maintained distance was the established safety buffer between infected and uninfected.
source_quote: Twenty feet of maintained distance. Separate food.

subject: Zalthir's weapon
fact: Zalthir used a weapon that dealt sixteen damage on the first strike and fifteen on the second, totaling thirty-one.
source_quote: I drove the weapon in. Sixteen... The second strike... Fifteen more. Thirty-one total.

subject: Ilvara's scream
fact: Ilvara screamed at herself — a sign her illusion of invulnerability had been broken.
source_quote: She screamed... at herself. And I caught that — I filed it... She was furious at herself.

subject: Cavern floor
fact: The cavern floor was the site of Ilvara's transformation, the Dust of Suleiman hazard, and the fungal cloud.
source_quote: She reappeared somewhere else on the cavern floor... I looked at the Dust of Suleiman area... twenty feet of spore-thick poison, sitting in the middle of the battlefield...

subject: Thorin's tactical observation
fact: Thorin noted that Jorlan was a threat with a location — predictable and targetable.
source_quote: Jorlan is not complicated. Jorlan is a threat with a location, which is the best kind of threat because it tells you exactly where to aim.

subject: Bridge
fact: The bridge was the site of the Glyph of Warding inscription and Jorlan's stationary position.
source_quote: Jorlan's side. He moved to the crossing and started inscribing the Glyph of Warding into the stone itself...

subject: Asha's frame shift
fact: Asha discarded the divine claim and replaced it with a deluded-mage frame — believing spores and Zuggtmoy's influence.
source_quote: Oh, dear goodness, have you two been infected by the spores, possessed by the crazed magic of Zuggtmoy? Convinced of the bride's power? Is this another trick of Ilvara's?

subject: Dancing Lights
fact: Dancing Lights were threaded down like a column of divine attention, absorbed into the speaker and blinking out.
source_quote: The Dancing Lights threading down like a column of divine attention, absorbed into the familiar, absorbed into me, blinking out.

subject: Zalthir's tactical exhaustion
fact: Zalthir was out of actions and bonus actions after teleporting and grappling Ilvara, leaving him with altitude and view but no further capacity.
source_quote: I hung in the air. Out of actions. Out of bonus actions. Out of everything I'd had when I arrived...

subject: Underdark equivalent of a table
fact: The party spread out tactical options on the Underdark equivalent of a table while crouched in the dark.
source_quote: Then the party spread out the options on the table, or whatever the Underdark equivalent of a table is when you're crouched in the dark...

subject: Ilvara's fungal transformation
fact: Ilvara transformed into fungal matter and reappeared elsewhere, indicating a connection to the Big Heart Fungus.
source_quote: She came apart into the fungal matter beneath her feet — flowed through it like water pouring into a crack... and reappeared somewhere else...

subject: Asha's final frame
fact: Asha accepted a spore-maddened wizard with followers and a gelatinous familiar as the best available instrument for killing Ilvara.
source_quote: Asha Vandree had seen through my lie, built her own explanation out of the wreckage, found it workable, and decided that a spore-maddened wizard with followers and a gelatinous familiar was, on balance, the best available instrument for killing someone she needed dead.

subject: glyph detonation
fact: The Glyph of Warding detonated, dealing 21 damage to spore servants and Jorlan, killing one servant outright and staggering the others, with Jorlan taking full force.
source_quote: Come get it, idiot

subject: glyph detonation
fact: The glyph's explosion was unexpected by Grygum, who exclaimed 'I didn't expect it to work' with genuine surprise.
source_quote: I didn't expect it to work

subject: spore servant count
fact: Four spore servants rose from the cavern floor with patient, purposeless movement — former Velkynvelve guards repurposed by Zuggtmoy's influence through Ilvara's corruption.
source_quote: Four shapes. Rising from the cavern floor with the patient, purposeless movement of things that are no longer choosing to move — they are simply directed. Former Velkynvelve guards.

subject: spore servant count
fact: One spore servant ceased to be a problem after the glyph detonated, while others staggered in a way suggesting they had not enjoyed the experience.
source_quote: One spore servant ceased to be a problem. The others staggered in a way that suggested they had not enjoyed the experience.

subject: fireball impact
fact: Daz's concentrated Fireball struck Ilvara and the Zuggtmoy icon simultaneously, each taking 12 damage, while sculpting the spell to spare Zalthir and Thorin.
source_quote: Daz's shaped Fireball hit — Ilvara and the Zuggtmoy icon both, simultaneously — and the two effects overlapped in a way that exceeded what either spell would have done alone.

subject: fireball impact
fact: Daz's Fireball worked better than expected, altering the battlefield math and shifting favor to the party despite both targets still standing.
source_quote: That worked better than I had any right to expect.

subject: dust of suleiman casting
fact: The Dust of Suleiman was cast directly onto the Big Heart Fungus, a high-cost resource deployed because the creature had already demonstrated its willingness to harm the party.
source_quote: I committed the Dust of Suleiman and cast it directly onto the fungus. This was not a small resource. I made the decision anyway, because the creature had already demonstrated what it was willing to do to us...

subject: spore line elevation
fact: The spore line hung above the cavern floor, marking the boundary from which characters spoke while hovering — a tactical vantage point.
source_quote: from somewhere above the spore line

subject: bridge elevation
fact: The bridge bore the Glyph of Warding, placed with the expectation of chaotic combat, and was the focal point of Jorlan's fatal advance.
source_quote: The Glyph of Warding on the bridge was still live. We'd placed it with exactly this kind of chaos in mind...

subject: glyph of warding value
fact: The Glyph of Warding was a tactical gamble — a trap laid to exploit ego overriding caution — and it succeeded, dealing 21 damage and killing one servant.
source_quote: The tactic had been a gamble — you call a man an idiot and invite him toward an explosive ward and you are making a bet on ego overriding tactical awareness...

subject: jorlan's advance
fact: Jorlan committed fully to the bridge, running without hesitation — a display of giant-brained certainty that ignored terrain danger and led to his downfall.
source_quote: Jorlan didn't hesitate, didn't slow — he came across that bridge like a man who had already decided the outcome. You have to respect that, a little, even when the outcome is about to be wrong for him. There's something almost giant-brained about that kind of certainty.

subject: thorin's sap maneuver
fact: After the glyph detonated, Thorin pressed the attack with Dawnbringer, landing a critical hit for 14 damage and using Sap to shove Jorlan off-balance.
source_quote: I was already closing on Jorlan... Dawnbringer came down — crit... 14 damage landing exactly where it needed to... I pressed the Sap after it...

subject: daz's sculpted spell precision
fact: Daz used Sculpt Spells to ensure the Fireball avoided Zalthir and Thorin while striking Ilvara and the icon — precision as directed force.
source_quote: I carve them out. The fire will know the shape of them by the time it arrives and it will go around — not because fire cares, fire doesn't care about anything, but because I told it the shape of what it cannot touch.

subject: cavern floor elevation
fact: The cavern floor was the origin point of the spore servants and the fungal threat — the battlefield's anchor, once passive, now an active enemy.
source_quote: The fight was far from over. But the battlefield had shifted in our favor... the Big Heart Fungus. Still standing. Still anchoring the far end of the battlefield.

subject: ilvara's summoning
fact: Ilvara called up the spore servants with purposeless, directed movement — a manifestation of Zuggtmoy's influence made visible through her corruption.
source_quote: Then Ilvara called them up. Four shapes. Rising from the cavern floor with the patient, purposeless movement of things that are no longer choosing to move — they are simply directed.

subject: zalthir's reflection on valen
fact: Zalthir silently reflected on Valen — who had once been exactly what the servants were — and noted the loss of identity between then and now.
source_quote: Then he reflected on Valen. Not out loud, really — it was more in the quality of the silence that followed. I felt the thought land in the room anyway. Valen, who had been one of them. Who could have been one of them, differently categorized.

subject: grygum's tactical insight
fact: Grygum's strategy — baiting ego with a trap — succeeded because Jorlan's certainty overrode caution, a gamble that paid off.
source_quote: The tactic had been a gamble — you call a man an idiot and invite him toward an explosive ward and you are making a bet on ego overriding tactical awareness, which is sometimes a safe bet and sometimes gets you killed. This time it paid.

subject: daz's tactical note-taking
fact: Daz noted the conditions that made the Fireball succeed — target positioning, spell sculpting, and timing — in case they became relevant again.
source_quote: I note that Zalthir is unsinged. I note that Thorin is unsinged. I don't say anything about it. It was the plan. Plans working is not remarkable. But I notice.

subject: battlefield shift
fact: The battlefield shifted in favor due to the combined effects of the glyph, fireball, and resource commitment — baiting ego, trusting the glyph, committing the resource, letting Daz do what Daz does.
source_quote: I noted the specific combination of factors that had produced that outcome: bait the ego, trust the glyph, commit the resource, let Daz do what Daz does.

subject: big heart fungus status
fact: The Big Heart Fungus remained standing despite all attacks — still anchoring the far end of the battlefield and the reason Zalthir hovered above the fight.
source_quote: The fungus was still standing. The fight was far from over.

subject: daz's self-perception
fact: Daz recognized the irony of being the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard — a role he achieved through precision, not flamboyance.
source_quote: I am the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard. The irony is almost invisible, even to me.
